NBA Player Value & Projection Model — 2026-27 By Cyro Asseo

Every player's 2025-26 LEBRON WAR converted into an open-market dollar valuation and set against his actual 2026-27 cap hit, to rank who the league is underpaying and overpaying. Seven-year trajectories come from blended empirical and parametric aging curves, historical-similarity comps and Monte Carlo simulation. Inspired by FiveThirtyEight's CARMELO NBA Player Projections models. For inquiries, email cyro@cyroasseo.com or send a direct message on your social media platform of choice, @CyroAsseo. Click or hover any point on a projection chart for the season-by-season detail.
